stage_seed_derivation: c3_seed = 1510000 + stage_id * 100000 + population_index; stage_id dev=1 validation=2 confirmation=3
weight_rule: weight[j] = +25 when h(c3_seed,j) is even, otherwise -25
bias_rule: bias = +16 when h(c3_seed,16) is even, otherwise -16
route_rule: reuse the fixed arm19 75-percent projection gate and training-side prototype metadata; do not randomize routing
updates: zero accepted updates; C3 residual state is generated before any population data are read
parameter_norm_basis: 416 equals sixteen fixed weight magnitudes25 plus fixed bias magnitude16 from the source-level arm19 one-update bounds; no observed C2 result may set this value
expected_control_outcome: C3 must fail the fixed C2 primary win rule and must fail the nonspecific-benefit sentinel; otherwise N18 is mechanistically invalid
freeze_requirement: This exact manifest must be individually hashed into the final N18 freeze and may not change after first exposure
